title: AgentRunOutput
description: Canonical output structure every CollectRx autonomous agent must produce and POST to /api/agent-runs

agentName.description: Kebab-case name matching the agent file. E.g. 'analytics-pipeline', 'risk-radar'.

severity.description: Highest severity finding in this run. OK means no issues found.

score.description: Optional 0–100 health/quality score. Include only when the agent defines a scoring rubric.

summary.description: One-paragraph plain-English summary of what the agent found. Readable by Khalid without context.

domain.description: Which risk/quality domain. E.g. 'PHI Breach', 'Carrier Block', 'Financial Integrity'

action.description: Exact next step. Imperative. Who does what by when.

evidence.description: SQL result, log excerpt, or metric value that triggered the finding.

downstream.description: Agent names that should read this output as input. Triggers are handled by the runtime.

raw.description: Full structured payload (metrics, SQL results, transcripts) for downstream agents to query. Not shown to Khalid directly.
